summary: V494 adds independent per-mechanism, per-channel commitments with optional coldkey-paid burns, exact per-mechanism validator weight delegation, root-configurable basket trade band/reference/refill controls preserving legacy defaults, and a root-configurable 360-block Etao owner-update limit. Commitment migration and retirement are bounded and terminal cleanup probes are metered. Runtime spec version 494 and transaction version 2 require signers and indexers to regenerate metadata. The full release guide includes CLI, Python SDK, and raw extrinsic examples, compatibility notes, and planned post-merge sudo calls.
